entry.title: HRBL: 8-K/A - Current report, amendment
entry.summary: (HW11 fixture, fictional company.) Harborline Bancorp. Amendment No. 1 to the 8-K of November 24, filed to correct the number of affected customers from about 1.2 million to about 1.15 million. No other changes.

entry.title: HRBL: 8-K - Current report
entry.summary: (HW11 fixture, fictional company.) Harborline Bancorp. Item 2.01 Completion of Acquisition or Disposition of Assets: Harborline completed its acquisition of Pinecrest Savings Bank for $410M in cash and stock.
